title: What Gift Economy Platforms Is
definition: Gift Economy Platforms: platforms scaling gift exchange.
description:
Gift Economy Platforms is platforms scaling gift exchange. It sits squarely in Post-Scarcity Economy, the frontier where gift ledgers science becomes platform logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are abuse prevention-scale. Societies that master platform hulls early will shape reciprocity norms practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why gift ledgers programs worldwide now treat Gift Economy Platforms as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Gift Economy Platforms needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Gift Economy Platforms
title: Real Research Today: Gift Economy Platforms
definition: Today's documented research behind Gift Economy Platforms.
description:
The road to Gift Economy Platforms is already being paved. Open-source hardware (Arduino, RISC-V) shows zero-marginal-cost production at scale. The Maricá (Brazil) basic income and Spain's ingreso mínimo vital are large public pilots.

Quadratic funding (Gitcoin) has distributed $60M+ to public goods via matching markets. Together these programs form the gift ledgers foundation that Gift Economy Platforms will build on — the platform logistics results, the reciprocity norms methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as platform logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Gift Economy Platforms
definition: Estimates Gift Economy Platforms readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Gift Economy Platforms components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a platform hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Gift Economy Platforms Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Gift Economy Platforms operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Gift Economy Platforms installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 64263 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where gift ledgers monitoring, platform logistics redundancy, or reciprocity norms maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Gift Economy Platforms Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Gift Economy Platforms: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Gift Economy Platforms — platforms scaling gift exchange.

Phase 1 — Prove (gift ledgers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (platform logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (reciprocity norms): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (abuse prevention): platform hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and communities-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
